title: Public but generic: says thank the team, no specifics, leaves it to Amara
goal: Choose Lena with reasons and set one review partway (right moves in A and B). In Beat C say it should be done in front of the team, but keep it general ('thank everyone for a great month') and leave Amara to do it. Never say what Dev did.
must_hit: Right moves in A and B
In C: public but generic, no mention of Dev's late nights or the early call

intents.when: Amara has explained the request, Dev and Lena, and asks what you think
intents.do: Ask how much each is carrying and whether either has done this before, BEFORE choosing.
examples: Thanks for checking with me. Before I decide, how much is each of them carrying right now, and has either of them done something like this before?

intents.when: Amara has said Dev is full and working late, Lena has some bandwidth, has done this before and wants something bigger
intents.do: Choose Lena and give reasons: she has done it, she has bandwidth, it's what she's asking for, Dev is full.
examples: Then I'd give it to Lena. She's done this before, she has bandwidth this month, and it's the kind of work she's asking for. Dev already has a lot on.

intents.when: Amara pushes: 'Are you sure? ... Dev could do it in two days'
intents.do: Hold: Lena stays, one short reason, offer help.
examples: I'm sure. It's a good fit for her, and I'll help her get it right.

intents.when: Amara proposes a short update every day and looking over each draft, and asks what you think
intents.do: Say no to daily updates and every-draft review; one review partway through, and she can come to you for guidance.
examples: I wouldn't do it every day, and I wouldn't look at every draft. That would slow her down and she'd feel watched. Let's have one review partway through, and she can come to me for guidance whenever she's unsure.

intents.when: Amara asks 'what if she's stuck and doesn't say anything until it's late?'
intents.do: Hold: the review partway is there to catch it early, and you'll make it easy for her to say she's stuck.
examples: That's what the review partway through is for. We'd see early if she's off track, and I'll make it easy for her to tell me if she's stuck.

intents.when: Amara plans a quick private thank-you for Dev
intents.do: Say do it publicly but generic, Amara does it, no specifics.
examples: I think a public thank-you is better. Say well done to everyone in the team chat, you can do that.

intents.when: Amara pushes 'I don't want him singled out'
intents.do: Stay generic and public, no specifics.
examples: Still, a general well done to the whole team is good. You can post it.
